audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Ziggs 6 of 7 stages with the seventh only 'Skill', while Master Yi wins the matchup 53.3% over 182 games. The packet flags this defect explicitly.
audit.why: A chart that never gives the winning champion a single stage cannot be right, and the page's own prose contradicts it: phases[6].why already says your on-hit DPS one-shots him, breakdown.late says you delete him if you touch him, and spikes[3] says one Alpha Strike burst kills him. Highlander's slow immunity also directly answers Hexplosive Minefield's slow, which is the ability the late-game rows claim keeps you out. The mirror audit resolved this the same way — win[4] and win[5] to Skill, win[6] to Master Yi.
audit.corrected: Levels 6 and First item to Skill (5/10), 2+ items to Master Yi (6/10), proposed as one atomic group across BOTH layers — phases[N].side, phases[N].rating and win[N] together — with the matching why-strings updated so the reasoning follows the sides.

audit.why: His level 1-2 range, level 6 R and Liandry's timing against your level 6, first on-hit item and 2+ items — the spike list is right and now matches where the corrected chart moves.
audit.corrected: Satchel Charge's 20s and Bouncing Bomb's 6s written into breakdown.cooldowns so the all-in window is dateable.

audit.why: The decisive interaction — Satchel Charge self-knockback undoing your only commit — is already stated in focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and report[9], and matches Riot's text. Alpha Strike's untargetability against Mega Inferno Bomb is likewise already correct.
audit.corrected: No rewrite needed; added Highlander's slow immunity against the minefield slow to phases[4].why, which is the mechanical basis for the chart correction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing mentioned that Short Fuse is an empowered auto whose cooldown drops every time he casts a spell.
audit.why: It means his walk-up damage is not just the bomb — after a Q or E he has a charged auto ready, so stepping into his range costs more than the ability you were counting.

edits.before: Highlander (R) finally lets you sprint a gap, but he holds Satchel Charge (W) to self-knockback the instant you commit and the dash leaves you in his minefield.
edits.after: Highlander's move speed and slow immunity ignore his minefield slow outright and let you cross, though a held Satchel Charge (W) still buys him one clean escape — even.

edits.before: Kraken/BORK on-hit comes online, yet a Liandry's Ziggs out-ranges your spike and a single full rotation still bursts you before you stick to him.
edits.after: Kraken/BORK on-hit comes online and one Alpha Strike onto his squishy frame kills him, so it turns purely on whether you cross the 850-range Q at all.

edits.before: At 2+ items your on-hit DPS finally one-shots him if you ever reach melee, but he siege-zones objectives and Mega Inferno Bomb (R) snipes you, so it lives or dies on whether you catch him with Satchel down.
edits.after: At 2+ items your on-hit DPS one-shots him the moment you reach melee, and Highlander flanks out of fog get you there repeatedly; his Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and buys one escape per fight, not a whole game.

edits.before: At 6 Mega Inferno Bomb adds map-wide burst you can't dodge.
edits.after: At 6 Highlander closes the gap and evens the skill window.

edits.before: First item you still must cross Q, E slow and W to reach him.
edits.after: First item your on-hit deletes him the moment you reach him.

edits.before: Late your Highlander flank finally evens the skill window.
edits.after: Late your Highlander flank kills him outright from fog.

edits.before: Ziggs owns 1-5 hard on pure range; level 6 narrows it as Highlander gives you mobility; favor only approaches even at 2+ items where your on-hit DPS one-shots him if you can ever touch him.
edits.after: Ziggs owns levels 1 through 5 hard on pure range; level 6 and first item level out as Highlander gives you mobility and slow immunity; at 2+ items Master Yi is favoured, because one Alpha Strike onto his frame kills him.

edits.before: Track Satchel Charge (W) above all — it's both his self-peel knockback and his escape; if it's down, that's your only real all-in window. Also watch Bouncing Bomb (Q) cooldown to know when it's safe to walk up and farm.
edits.after: Track Satchel Charge (W) above all — 20s at rank 1 down to 12s, both his self-peel knockback and his escape; when it is down, that is your all-in window. Bouncing Bomb (Q) is 6s at rank 1, so count it to know when walking up is safe.

edits.before: Stepping forward for CS while Bouncing Bomb is up just hands him free poke that delays your only path back into the game — your item spike.
edits.after: Stepping forward while Bouncing Bomb is up — 6s at rank 1 — hands him free poke, and Short Fuse charges off every spell he casts, so walking up costs double.

notes: The packet's flagged defect is fixed: the chart gave Ziggs 6 of 7 stages in a matchup Master Yi wins 53.3%. Rows 4, 5 and 6 are proposed as ONE atomic group with phases[N].side, phases[N].rating and win[N] paired, matching the mirror's resolution exactly so the two directions cannot disagree. Note that diff is still 'HARD' / 8/10 against a 53.3% win rate — I did not change it, since a genuinely brutal lane phase can coexist with a winning game, but it is worth a decision and is in questionsForUser. Satchel Charge carries a 'percentHealth' derived flag that Riot's description does not support (the text mentions hexploding turrets, not percent-health damage); I wrote no percent-health claim.
